title: Image generation tool + auto-segmentation tool integration
implementation_notes: gen_image: Anthropic API backend (optional) + deterministic placeholder SVG fallback using MD5 hash of prompt for color
autosegment: rembg (optional/MIT) -> GrabCut (cv2/Apache-2.0) -> Otsu (cv2/numpy) fallback chain
No new pip dependencies added to pyproject.toml; all backends use optional imports with try/except
Both tools return JSON-serializable dicts with ok, path, width, height, backend, message keys
